**Claimed critical; verifier found:** verifier off

Empty `MATRIX` always fails the gate, but this workflow re-fires on **every** `labeled` event (not only `ready`). After a successful `ready` review turns `Self-review gate` green on SHA N, adding `bug` / `dependencies` / `self-reviewed:anthropic` re-runs the workflow, `scope` emits `matrix=[]`, and this branch fails the gate again. Branch protection keeps the **latest** check run for that name+SHA, so the prior green is clobbered and merge is blocked until someone re-toggles `ready`.

Fix options (pick one):
1. **Event-aware no-op:** when `github.event.action == 'labeled'` and the label is not `ready`, exit 0 (or skip the gate job) so an unrelated label does not rewrite the required check.
2. **Honor a prior success on this SHA:** if `MATRIX` is empty, query check-runs for `Self-review gate` on `github.event.pull_request.head.sha` and pass when a successful conclusion already exists (needs `permissions.checks: read`).
3. Narrow `on.pull_request.types` so non-gate labels cannot re-enter this workflow (harder if you still want `opened` + `labeled` for `ready` only — GitHub cannot filter by label name at the `on:` layer).

Also mirror the same fix in the consumer recipe in `docs/TRIGGER_MODES.md` technique 3.

**Claimed critical; verifier found:** verifier off

The published recipe has the same failure mode as `self-review.yml`: technique 1 subscribes to all `labeled` events, technique 2 correctly skips the review job for non-`ready` labels, and technique 3 then **fails** the required check whenever `MATRIX` is `[]`. Consumers who copy this pattern will see a green gate after `ready`, then a red gate again the moment Dependabot or a human adds any other label on the same head SHA.

When you fix the workflow gate, update this snippet in the same PR — either skip/pass on non-gate `labeled` events, or document that the gate must consult a prior successful check-run on the head SHA before failing empty-matrix.

The comment says the only empty-matrix path (with secrets configured) is a missing `ready` label, and the `::error::` tells maintainers to apply `ready`. That is incomplete: if `ready` is present but `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` (and the other provider secrets) are unset, `scope` still emits `matrix=[]` and the gate fails with the same message. Prefer distinguishing "label gate closed" vs "no provider secret configured" in the error text so a misconfigured repo is not chased as a label-toggle problem.

This PR renames the recipe heading to **"Recipe: run once when labelled `ready`, block merge until it passes"**, but `README.md:291` still links to the old heading **"…and show Skipped (not green)"**. GitHub heading anchors follow the current title, so the Marketplace-facing deep link is now a dead section reference. Update the README sentence in the same PR (and optionally mention the new merge-gate behaviour).

summary:
## Verdict

I'd recommend **not merging** until the merge-gate job stops clobbering a prior green `Self-review gate` on non-`ready` `labeled` events — the core idea is right, but the current implementation breaks the gate after a successful review.

## What works

The diagnosis is correct and important: GitHub branch protection treats a **Skipped** required check as passing, so requiring the dynamic `Self-review — <provider>` legs never actually blocked merge. A stable-named final job with `if: always()` is the right shape.

Also solid:
- `needs: [scope, self-review]` + `if: always()` so the gate still runs when `self-review` is skipped
- Scope-result check before trusting the matrix
- `fail-fast: false` awareness when requiring `REVIEW_RESULT == success`
- Env-mapped values (no `${{ pull_request.* }}` shell interpolation)
- Explicit `permissions:` block already present
- CHANGELOG + TRIGGER_MODES updates for the new recipe name

## Blocking issue

**Gate clobber on unrelated labels.** Workflow `on: types: [opened, labeled]` fires for *any* label. After a successful `ready` review paints `Self-review gate` green on head SHA N, adding `bug`, `dependencies`, or even `self-reviewed:anthropic` re-runs the workflow. `scope` correctly emits `matrix=[]`, and the new gate step **fails** that empty matrix. Branch protection keeps the **latest** check-run for the name+SHA, so the prior success is replaced by failure and merge stays blocked until someone re-toggles `ready`.

The same pattern is copy-pasted into the consumer recipe in `docs/TRIGGER_MODES.md` technique 3 — fix both together.

Practical fixes (any one is enough):
1. Event-aware pass/skip when `labeled` and the label ≠ `ready`
2. On empty matrix, look up an existing successful `Self-review gate` check-run on the head SHA (`checks: read`)
3. Otherwise document a different outer trigger that cannot re-enter on non-gate labels

## Other notes

- Empty-matrix `::error::` always blames a missing `ready` label; missing
